_comment: General archetype ROUTE corrections and route adjudications - NOT support-only (scope broadened 2026-07-25 by RM-80 / A-15, which adjudicated the Fighter-tagged on-hit cohort in this same file rather than inventing a second lookup; the filename is kept for import stability). Consumed by core.archetype_picks.default_for_champion via core.ds_support_route_overrides.load_support_route_overrides(). ONLY the 'champions' block is loaded at runtime - '_held' and '_rm80_onhit_sweep' are adjudication provenance, so recording a REFUTE here costs nothing at runtime. FOUNDING COHORT (Slice C, 2026-07-18, RM-84): tag_to_archetype('Support') == 'enchanter', so all 18 Support-tag-first champions route to ds.hps. axis_correct_archetype only resolves AD-vs-AP conflicts, so it rescues Pyke (Assassin) and Senna (Marksman) but CANNOT see an AP-vs-AP misroute. Each entry below is adjudicated per champion against live 16.14 Emerald+ pick-rate data, route-first: an override lands only when the CURRENT route's top-3 items have a ~0% real pick rate AND the target route's pool is the right item family. Champions with no expressible route, and champions whose current route was adjudicated CORRECT, are deliberately ABSENT (see _held). ASCII only.
_evidence_sources: aggregator A + aggregator D Emerald+ 16.14; enchanter-pool probe = Echoes of Helia > Ardent Censer > Staff of Flowing Water > Locket > Knight's Vow > Redemption, byte-identical for every champion routed to it

_held._comment: Adjudicated and deliberately NOT overridden, for one of two reasons: (a) no current scorer expresses the kit, so flipping would swap one anchor violation for another (Renata Glasc, Zilean); or (b) the CURRENT route was measured to be the best available one, so the filed misroute is REFUTED (Master Yi). Tracked so a later sweep does not re-litigate a settled row.
_held.Renata Glasc: Real build splits tank-engage (Locket ~50%, Knight's Vow ~10%) against utility-mage (Imperial Mandate ~40%, Shurelya's ~25%), with Redemption ~15% genuinely inside the enchanter pool. No single route dominates; tank would drop Mandate/Shurelya's, mage would offer Liandry's/Blackfire which she never builds.
_held.Master Yi: RM-80 / A-15 REFUTED at ENGINE 1.245.0 / patch 16.14.1. Filed as 'on-hit attack-speed carry mis-routed to the bruiser scorer'; measured on live :8893, the bruiser route (ds.hybrid) is the BEST available route and ds.onhit is worse. His real build (aggregator A 2026-05-02 via data/meta_build/sr_champion_builds.json) is Kraken Slayer > Berserker's > Guinsoo's Rageblade > Experimental Hexplate > Death's Dance > Guardian Angel - two of six slots are DEFENSIVE, which the blended alpha*dps + beta*ehp bruiser scorer credits and a pure-DPS on-hit scorer cannot. Seeded at his real 3-item core (6672/3006/3124, level 13, target 80 armor / 60 MR / 2200 max HP / 1200 bonus HP), /rank-bruiser places Experimental Hexplate at #24 of 138 and Death's Dance at #37; /rank-onhit demotes them to #43 and #39. The Slice-C bar also fails outright: the bruiser top-3 is Blade of The Ruined King (his documented alt core, 57.98% WR) > Trinity Force > Lord Dominik's Regards (his documented vs-tank 4th, 62.37% WR), so two of three are genuinely-built items, nowhere near the ~0% pick rate an override requires. Separately, ds.onhit is the on-hit-AP scorer (core/ds_onhit_ap_roster.json holds Gwen / Kayle / KogMaw); adding an AD carry there is a category error, not a fix.
_held.Zilean: Real build is AP UTILITY (Solstice Sleigh 57.5%, Shurelya's, Imperial Mandate, Locket, Cosmic Drive). Liandry's, Luden's, Malignance and Rylai's are ALL absent, so the mage route's top-2 (Liandry's > Blackfire) would be a fresh never-build violation; the tank route's Randuin's/Jak'Sho are equally absent. Unrepresentable by any of the 7 scorers.

Morgana.evidence: Liandry's Torment leads her legendaries (45.7% first-item on aggregator D Em+, ~12.6% on aggregator A's slot-1 table) with Blackfire, Rylai's and Zhonya's behind it; the mage route returns exactly that order. Ardent Censer and Staff of Flowing Water - the enchanter route's #2 and #3 - have a literal 0.00% pick rate at every build depth in every role, across aggregator A's full ~19,100-game support table complete down to 0.41%.

Thresh.evidence: Tank-engage warden: Solstice Sleigh 53.03% quest, then Locket, Zeke's, Knight's Vow, Thornmail (55.47% WR at 4th). All six heal/shield-throughput legendaries are ZERO. Tank is the right FAMILY; see _aura_caveat.

Rakan.evidence: Celestial Opposition 65.19% quest, Solstice Sleigh 28.76%, then Locket + Knight's Vow + Zeke's co-occurring in a 13.35% core build. Only Redemption appears at ~1.4% (227 games, 4th item); the other five enchanter legendaries are ZERO. Single DDragon tag ['Support'], so the tag path had no secondary to fall back to.

Taric.evidence: Warden/armor: Solstice Sleigh 31.26% vs Dream Maker 30.16% quest split, then Knight's Vow ~13.9%, Locket ~3.3%, Frozen Heart, Zeke's ~1.7%. All six enchanter LEGENDARIES are ZERO on both sources; the Dream Maker share is a support-quest item, not a legendary, so it does not evidence the ds.hps pool.

Bard.evidence: Tank-engage: Dead Man's Plate ~11.4%, Locket ~2.9%, Knight's Vow present. Ardent, Staff, Moonstone and Helia are ZERO (Mikael's ~6.4% and Redemption are the only enchanter-pool showings). CAVEAT: the two sources disagree on his quest item - aggregator A reads Bloodsong 58.69% (an AD upgrade), aggregator D reads Solstice Sleigh leading. The legendary tail is tank on both, which is what the route selects; re-check the quest split next sweep.

_rm80_onhit_sweep._comment: RM-80 / A-15 sibling sweep (2026-07-25, ENGINE 1.245.0 / patch 16.14.1). Root-cause-first: rather than patch Master Yi alone, every one of the 44 bruiser-primary champions was enumerated via core.archetype_picks.default_for_champion over data/meta/ddragon_champions.json, and the 11 whose real meta build (data/meta_build/sr_champion_builds.json) contains an on-hit item - Guinsoo's Rageblade, Wit's End, Terminus, Kraken Slayer, Blade of The Ruined King or Nashor's Tooth - were probed on BOTH /rank-bruiser and /rank-onhit against their OWN real build. RESULT: 0 of 11 move. Nothing is added to 'champions' by this sweep.
_rm80_onhit_sweep._method: Per champion: seed the first two items of its real full_build, level 13, target 80 armor / 60 MR / 2200 max HP / 1200 bonus HP, top=250 (the full 134-139 evaluated candidate set, so 'absent from the list' is never mistaken for evidence), then compare the mean rank each route assigns to the REST of that champion's real build.
_rm80_onhit_sweep._family_failure: The decisive cross-champion finding: ds.onhit sums ability DPS and auto DPS, so for an AD champion it over-credits AP burn items. Liandry's Torment lands in the /rank-onhit top-3 for Nilah, Yasuo, Yone, Bel'Veth, Shyvana, Warwick and Jax - a fresh never-build violation the bruiser route does not commit. So even for the four champions where /rank-onhit scored a marginally better mean rank (Nilah 11.2 vs 13.8, Tryndamere 9.2 vs 12.0, Yasuo 32.2 vs 37.5, Yone 34.2 vs 35.8), the target route's POOL is the wrong item family and the Slice-C bar - top-3 at ~0% pick rate AND a right-family target pool - fails on its second clause.

champions.Nilah: KEEP bruiser. onhit mean-rank 11.2 vs bruiser 13.8, but the bruiser top-3 is Blade of The Ruined King and Immortal Shieldbow - both in her real build - so the ~0% clause fails, and the onhit top-3 leads with Liandry's Torment, an AP item she never builds.
champions.Bel'Veth: KEEP bruiser, decisively. bruiser mean-rank 39.5 vs onhit 59.2; onhit buries her real Jak'Sho at #135 of 135.
champions.Irelia: KEEP bruiser. bruiser 30.2 vs onhit 39.4. Genuine bruiser - Hullbreaker / Death's Dance / Sterak's Gage are half her build.
champions.Shyvana: KEEP bruiser, decisively. bruiser 16.8 vs onhit 64.2; onhit buries her real Jak'Sho at #134 of 134.
champions.Viego: KEEP bruiser. bruiser 19.2 vs onhit 20.0 - effectively a tie, and a tie does not clear an override bar.
champions.Yasuo: KEEP bruiser. onhit 32.2 vs bruiser 37.5, but the onhit top-3 is Lord Dominik's > Liandry's Torment > Terminus; Liandry's is a never-build for him, so the target pool is the wrong family.
champions.Yone: KEEP bruiser. onhit 34.2 vs bruiser 35.8 (noise), and the onhit route ranks Liandry's Torment #1 for him - the worst family violation in the sweep.
champions.Tryndamere: KEEP bruiser. onhit 9.2 vs bruiser 12.0, but the bruiser top-3 already leads with Blade of The Ruined King, which IS in his real build, so the ~0% clause fails. His build is crit - Phantom Dancer / Infinity Edge - not on-hit stacking.
champions.Warwick: KEEP bruiser, decisively. bruiser 41.0 vs onhit 78.2; onhit buries his real Jak'Sho at #136 of 136 and Thornmail at #122.
champions.Jax: KEEP bruiser. bruiser 30.0 vs onhit 44.8. Wit's End is one on-hit item inside an otherwise Sundered Sky / Sterak's Gage bruiser core.

_rm80_onhit_sweep._also_spot_checked: Xin Zhao, Yorick, Nasus, Udyr, Volibear - genuine bruisers with no on-hit item in their meta build; not probed further.
_rm80_onhit_sweep._not_a_candidate: ds.onhit is the on-hit-AP scorer (Slice B). Its roster core/ds_onhit_ap_roster.json holds Gwen / Kayle / KogMaw and is AP-scaling by construction, so no AD on-hit carry belongs in it under the current schema. Widening the on-hit route to AD would be a scorer lift, not a routing fix.

_aura_caveat: Thresh / Rakan / Taric / Bard really build ALLY-AURA tank items (Locket, Knight's Vow, Zeke's, Solstice Sleigh). The tank route (ds.ehp) values SELF EHP, so it leads with Randuin's / Jak'Sho / Kaenic Rookern / Warmog's instead. That is the SETTLED team-aura scope limit (same limit logged in the Nautilus and Nami REFUTE verdicts), not a new defect. The override is still a strict improvement under the engine anchor: it stops the engine offering Echoes of Helia / Ardent Censer / Staff of Flowing Water as the top 3 to champions who never buy them at any depth.
